topic: External monitor black or not detected on a responsive MacBook Air or Pro
state: Prepared and locally checked for normal main publication. This pre-push QA snapshot does not assert live availability; post-push remote/deployment/public outcomes are recorded in the saved cloud handoff.
uniqueness: All64 local tips and current remote inventory inspected. Existing Mac audio and external-drive guides concern different devices/results; the Windows laptop black-screen guide tests a built-in Windows display. No existing Mac wired external-monitor guide.
scope: One directly connected wired monitor on a responsive MacBook Air/Pro with a working built-in screen; distinguish discovery, video path and native count/mode limits. AirPlay, Sidecar, a failed built-in screen and a Mac that does not start are outside scope.

sources.supports: Eject in Finder before disconnecting storage; read only ejection instructions, no erase step reproduced.
Monitor-side input selection and suitable video connections; no Windows settings copied into Mac procedure.
Direct connection, cable/mode limits, closed-lid requirements, detection, brightness and monitor firmware scope.
Video-capable ports/adapters and model-specific display support.
Apple silicon laptop accessory approval; locked state; charging can continue after denial. Guide retains global security defaults.
Current Detect Displays replaces Night Shift under Option; exact-model Help > Specifications lookup.
M4/M5 MacBook Air two external displays alongside built-in, limits depend on mode; lid closure adds none.
MacBook Pro chip variants have different counts/modes; older models need specifications.
Base M3 Air/Pro dual-display closed-lid setup, power/input devices,14.3 Air/14.6 Pro minimum and opening-lid behavior.
Versioned macOS26 resolution recovery:15seconds thenEscape; Default and version selector. Guide does not reproduce Safe mode/recovery sequence.
Normal restart and unsaved-change risk of forced shutdown.
Backup before compatible macOS update; model-supported updates and uninterrupted installation.

decisions: Use existing editorial template, shared navigation and scoped CSS; decorative video-path sketch and native disclosures need no article JavaScript.
Explain base M3 lid/power/input and minimum macOS requirements separately from M4/M5 Air and Pro/Max variants. Older models need exact specifications.
Preserve storage through Finder ejection before dock disconnects; warn about unsaved work and erasing unbacked-up files.
Do not disable accessory security globally, install random display drivers, open equipment, force responsive Macs off or erase/reinstall as part of these comparisons.
Twelve primary manufacturer references; no fabricated repair experience, business promises or product/affiliate recommendation.
Reviewed and publication metadata use October27; genuine source-based review date, not a manufacturer update claim.
Preserve all64 older guides byte-for-byte; add incoming links through /tips,/guides and /macbook-repair and useful related links from this guide.
